title: ClearPath Late-Fee History and the Administration Charge on Standard Endpoint Order Cancellations
content:
**Credit control note.** An administration charge is added to the endpoint cancellation fee of a Hardware Procurement Standard Endpoint Order cancelled after its purchase order by the ClearPath late fees posted on the client's ClearPath billing fewer than twelve whole months before the day the cancellation is recorded: **50.00 USD** for two or more such late fees, **25.00 USD** for exactly one, and nothing when there is none. Late fees on any other Stratton Bay account do not count.

The late fees counted are the late fee entries on the billing ledger of the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement.

| ClearPath late fees posted fewer than twelve whole months before the cancellation day | Administration charge added |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| exactly 1 | 25.00 |
| 2 | 50.00 |
| 3 or more | 50.00 |

**Points of judgement**

- A late fee posted eleven months before the cancellation day counts; one posted thirteen months before does not.
- A late fee on the client's Microsoft 365, security, backup, TimeBank, project or hardware billing is not a ClearPath late fee and does not count.
- The charge is a fixed amount; it does not depend on the size of the late fees or of the order.
